{{Quote|A Separatist saboteur attacked one of our Republic cruisers. A Mandalorian saboteur.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=MandalorianSaboteur-TMP.flac|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />}}
This '''saboteur''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was hired by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] a [[Unidentified Republic cruiser|Republic cruiser]]. The Mandalorian, however, was [[Attack on a Republic cruiser/Legends|attacked]] before he could complete his mission and captured after a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. He then committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] rather than submit to interrogation.

==Biography==
This [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] lived during the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a Mandalorian splinter group.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Mandalorian was tasked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which was at war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] a [[Unidentified Republic cruiser|Republic cruiser]]. However, before he could complete his mission, the Mandalorian was spotted, and a [[Attack on a Republic cruiser/Legends|firefight]] erupted between him and Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Despite trying to escape, the Mandalorian was captured. He then committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] to escape interrogation.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />

After the attempted sabotage, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] tasked [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to investigate the background of the Mandalorian. Kenobi showed a [[holograph]] of the Mandalorian to [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during his investigation. Almec and Kryze were both shocked by the brutality of the Mandalorian, as Kryze believed she had brought the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to an era of pacifism. Kenobi was later able to find the Death Watch [[Death Watch hideout|headquarters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]].<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He took his own life rather that submit to questioning.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=TookHisOwnLife-TMP.flac|<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />}}
This Mandalorian served in the Death Watch and was well-trained and agile. In battle, the Mandalorian was equipped with traditional [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]]. He decided to commit suicide rather than be interrogated by the Republic.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian's first and only appearance to date in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] was in "[[The Mandalore Plot]]," an episode from [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|the second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 29]], [[2010]].<ref name="Ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode212.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>
